sources.attribution: Chinese Wiktionary contributors (per-entry attribution_url links to page and history); raw extraction by Tatu Ylonen and Wiktextract contributors, https://kaikki.org/zhwiktionary/rawdata.html. Derived text data remains CC BY-SA 4.0; Cloudleaf tool code is separately MIT.
sources.transformations: Fixed compressed prefix inflated to complete original JSONL lines; trailing 139 bytes excluded. Import exact multi-character Han headwords with explicit Mandarin/Pinyin tags; preserve Chinese gloss language, sourced POS, explicit English translations, original-line digests and page URLs. Exclude media, quotation examples and entries with unreviewed rights markers. No frequency or script-conversion inference.
sources.scope: Bounded text excerpt for resource and consistency research; not complete raw dump, production lexicon or independent language evaluation.
limitations: Bounded first-byte excerpt with source-order bias, not complete Wiktionary or a production lexicon.
Original full download/hash and gzip CRC are not verified; plaintext excerpt hash and exact derivation are independently locked.
Chinese-edition glosses are Chinese; only explicitly sourced English translations are English, with no complete bilingual claim.

Wikimedia Terms of Use section 7 applies text CC BY-SA4; per-page import attribution/fair-use exceptions have not all been manually reviewed. Available source rights markers are retained or quarantined; no absolute exception-free guarantee.
No observed frequency, corpus period, language quality or independent accuracy evidence.
